item.title: The More Things Change
item.description: Noreen McCormick’s life takes a dramatic turn when she stumbles upon the mysterious Spells R Us store, guided by a friend’s suggestion. Noreen, a petite and attractive 25-year-old, seeks a way to change her life and escape her abusive husband, Rick.

item.title: Time Flies
item.description: In Spells R Us: Time Flies, Jason and his sister Sally face a challenging life with their neglectful Aunt Marcie. Their daily routine is marked by Marcie’s constant drinking and occasional outbursts.

item.title: Tried as a Juvenile
item.description: Jennifer Roberts and her mother Pam leave the Jameson County jail, facing the aftermath of Jennifer’s recent crime. At twenty-two, Jennifer’s joyride in a stolen car has turned into a serious felony, and her mother’s frustration is palpable.

item.title: Turnabout
item.description: Matt, caught in the middle of a prank war with his college roommates Chris and Steve, seeks a grand revenge to balance the scales. After enduring a messy prank involving whipped cream, Matt heads to the mall, hoping to find the perfect tool for his counterattack.

item.title: Unfinished Business
item.description: In “Unfinished Business…”, the world of academia and desire collide in a tale of betrayal and transformation. When Joseph Whitlow becomes the youngest dean in campus history, he’s not just celebrating his newfound power.

item.title: Unreally Real
item.description: In “Unreally Real,” by Ran Dandel, we dive into the world of cutting-edge virtual reality with a twist of magic. The story follows Terry Ralston, a gamer frustrated by the limitations of his VR setup.

item.title: You Are What You Eat
item.description: In the heart of the mall, little Ben Morris, dressed as a vampire, eagerly darted from store to store, filling his bag with candy on Halloween night. With his dad, Keith Morris, accompanying him, Ben’s excitement was palpable.

item.title: Breasteables: The Comic Revolutionizing the Breast Expansion Genre - Botcomics
item.description: Breasteables is a bold adult comic set in the Prohibition era, blending science fiction and breast expansion fetishes with an engaging storyline and striking artwork. Follow Sidney and her gang as they use experimental liquor to gain power in Dallas, in one of Botcomics' most original series.

item.title: Sexabeasts – Chasing the FerOrgy: A Wild Ride Through Furry Transformation and Sexual Evolution - Botcomics
item.description: Sexabeasts – Chasing the FerOrgy is a bold, new furry transformation comic from Botcomics that follows Mara, a cat-woman from planet Sexa-1, on her mission to reach the FerOrgy state through wild erotic adventures. Packed with breast expansion, domination, and intergalactic sex, it’s a must-read for fans of transformation erotica.
